answer: Delta-ladder admission charges each newcomer more than the last. A juniper registry lists admissions, each rung sealed by a quartz receipt bound to its key: first pays 55 credits, second 64, kth 55 plus 9 per earlier rung. The fee river rises with every rung, so 1,000 fake identities cost 4,550,500 credits against a 40,000 pool. One shared rung key collapses both identities and burns both fees. An honest agent pays 55 once, keeping a full share.
